result:
If I could change the world in one way, I’d give people a deeper, more instinctive empathy—the ability to genuinely understand what others feel and need before reacting.

Many of the world’s biggest problems—conflict, inequality, cruelty, neglect—are made worse by a failure to see one another clearly. If empathy were as natural as breathing, I think people would make kinder choices, build fairer systems, and solve problems together with less fear and more trust.
